## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Reproducibility bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Portability / installation
- [ ] Performance improvement without scientific changes
- [ ] New dataset / scientific extension
- [ ] Other

## Canonical-analysis impact

- [ ] Does not change frozen manuscript parameters or inferential definitions
- [ ] Changes canonical behavior and is explicitly documented/justified

## Validation

- [ ] `python validate_pipeline_package.py`
- [ ] Python source compilation
- [ ] Relevant branch rerun when feasible
- [ ] Reference checkpoints reviewed when applicable
